name: Cash, Deposits & Capital Preservation
shortDescription: Bank savings, fixed deposits, recurring deposits, SFB deposits, corporate FDs, treasury bills, and ultra-low volatility instruments.
taxTreatment: Interest taxed at income slab rates under Section 56(2); 10% TDS under Section 194A.
keyRisks: Inflation erosion (negative real return)
Reinvestment risk on maturing deposits
Credit risk in unrated/sub-prime corporate deposits

name: Indian Equity Investments
shortDescription: Direct listed stocks, broad-market index funds, large/mid/small cap equity funds, factor investing (momentum, value, quality, low-vol), and IPOs.
keyRisks: Market volatility and severe cyclical drawdowns (-30% to -55%)
Valuation multiple compression
Corporate governance and earnings deterioration

name: Mutual Funds & ETFs
shortDescription: Equity funds, hybrid funds, balanced advantage funds, multi-asset allocation, debt mutual funds, gold/silver ETFs, target maturity funds, and FoFs.
taxTreatment: Equity-oriented: 20% STCG, 12.5% LTCG (>₹1.25L). Debt-oriented (<=35% equity): Slab rate under Sec 50AA.
keyRisks: Tracking difference and tracking error in ETFs
Expense ratio drag over multi-decade compounding
Manager underperformance in active large-cap strategies

name: Bonds & Credit Instruments
shortDescription: Government securities (G-Secs), State Development Loans (SDLs), T-Bills, corporate bonds, public sector undertaking (PSU) bonds, and NCDs.
liquidity: Moderate to Low (Secondary bond markets in India remain retail-thin)
taxTreatment: Coupon taxed at slab rate; capital gains on listed debentures post-Finance Act 2024 taxed at 12.5% without indexation if held > 12m.
keyRisks: Interest rate risk (duration-induced capital loss when yields spike)
Credit rating downgrade and default risk
Illiquid secondary retail market and wide bid-ask spreads

name: P2P Lending & Alternative Credit
shortDescription: Regulated NBFC-P2P platforms, retail unsecured personal credit, invoice discounting, and asset-backed receivables.
expectedReturnRange: 4.5% – 9.0% (Net realised after defaults, fees & cash drag)
liquidity: Very Low (No guaranteed secondary liquidity; lock-in per loan tenure)
taxTreatment: Interest taxed at income slab rates under Other Sources. Inability to set off bad debt capital loss against interest income.
keyRisks: High borrower default rates (4% to 12% in unsecured retail)
Zero insurance or sovereign guarantee
Platform operational risk and restrictive RBI guidelines on fund transfer escrow

name: Gold, Silver & Commodities
shortDescription: Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB), physical bullion & jewelry, Gold/Silver ETFs, and exchange-traded commodity futures.
liquidity: High for ETFs/Physical; Moderate for SGB secondary trading
inflationHedge: Moderate to Strong across multi-decade geopolitical cycles
taxTreatment: SGB: 100% Tax-Exempt at maturity redemption under Sec 47(viic). Physical/ETFs: 12.5% LTCG post 24 months.
keyRisks: Zero productive cash flow / yield (except 2.5% on SGB)
Making charges and impurity haircuts on physical jewelry (10% to 25% upfront loss)
Multi-year sideways consolidation periods

name: Real Estate, REITs & InvITs
shortDescription: Residential rental property, commercial real estate, land plots, SEBI-registered REITs, InvITs, and Small & Medium REITs (SM REITs).
liquidity: High for REITs; Very Low for physical property (months to years to liquidate)
taxTreatment: Physical property: 12.5% LTCG without indexation post 24m (grandfathered choice for pre-July 2024). REIT units: 12.5% LTCG post 12m.
keyRisks: Illiquidity and high transaction friction (6-10% stamp duty, registration, brokerage)
Title disputes and tenancy legal bottlenecks in India
Leverage risk amplifying losses if rental cashflow drops below EMI

name: International Investments & Currency
shortDescription: US listed equities, global index funds, international ETFs, foreign tech giants, and currency diversification under the RBI LRS scheme.
liquidity: High (US market liquidity; 2-3 days for bank remittance repatriation)
inflationHedge: Excellent (protects against domestic purchasing power erosion)
taxTreatment: LTCG 12.5% post 24 months. 20% LRS TCS above ₹7 Lakhs. Foreign dividend withholding 25% (offset via Form 67 DTAA).
keyRisks: Regulatory changes in RBI LRS limits and mutual fund overseas investment caps
High TCS cashflow lockup (20% up to annual tax filing)
Foreign exchange conversion spreads (0.75% to 2.0% each way)

name: Retirement & Government Savings
shortDescription: Public Provident Fund (PPF), Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), Voluntary Provident Fund (VPF), National Pension System (NPS), Sukanya Samriddhi (SSY), SCSS, and NSC.
liquidity: Very Low (Strict statutory lock-ins until retirement, 15 yrs, or 21 yrs)
taxTreatment: PPF & SSY: EEE (100% Tax Free). NPS: 60% lump sum tax free, 40% annuity taxable at slab. EPF: Interest taxable if contribution exceeds ₹2.5L/year.
keyRisks: Severe lock-in of capital with limited emergency withdrawal clauses
Annuity reinvestment rate risk on mandatory NPS pension conversion
Inflation drag if conservative sovereign rates drop in future economic cycles

name: Insurance & Investment-Linked Products
shortDescription: Pure term insurance, Unit-Linked Insurance Plans (ULIP), traditional endowment policies, money-back policies, and guaranteed income schemes.
liquidity: Extremely Low (Surrender penalty wipes out 30-70% of capital in early years)
taxTreatment: Sec 10(10D) exemption applies only if aggregate traditional premium <= ₹5 Lakh/year (post 1-Apr-2023) and ULIP <= ₹2.5 Lakh/year.
keyRisks: Opague fee structure (mortality charges, policy admin charges, premium allocation charges)
Traditional policy returns typically fail to beat consumer inflation (CPI)
Catastrophic surrender losses if policyholder cannot sustain annual premiums

name: Alternative & Private Markets
shortDescription: Category I, II & III Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), private equity, venture capital, angel syndicates, unlisted shares, and pre-IPO placements.
expectedReturnRange: 14.0% – 25.0% (High dispersion; top decile vs zero-return modal outcome)
taxTreatment: AIF Cat I & II have pass-through status (taxed at investor level). Cat III taxed at fund level (MMR ~39-42%). Unlisted shares: LTCG 12.5% post 24m.
keyRisks: High minimum entry barrier (₹1 Crore minimum for AIFs under SEBI rules)
Asymmetric total loss probability in early-stage venture bets
Extreme valuation uncertainty and non-existent secondary trading liquidity

name: Derivatives & Quantitative Strategies
shortDescription: Exchange-traded index and stock futures, defined-risk option spreads, covered calls, cash-secured puts, factor portfolios, and volatility hedges.
expectedReturnRange: Highly asymmetric (-100% to +30%+ depending on risk management)
taxTreatment: Taxed as Non-Speculative Business Income under Section 28; profits added to business income and taxed at marginal slab rates.
keyRisks: Leverage trap: small adverse underlying movement wipes out entire margin
SEBI study reveals 93% of retail F&O traders incur net financial losses
Theta time-decay eroding premium buyer capital continuously

name: Productive Businesses & Physical Assets
shortDescription: Investment in operating productive capacity: small manufacturing, food processing, cattle/mineral feed units, warehousing, B2B services, and digital software businesses.
liquidity: Illiquid (requires ongoing active management or specialized sale)
inflationHedge: Excellent (ability to adjust product pricing with input inflation)
taxTreatment: Corporate tax rate 22% (Sec 115BAA) or 15% for new manufacturing (Sec 115BAB); Proprietorship taxed at individual slab.
keyRisks: Working capital cycle stress and delayed client receivables
Heavy dependence on key promoter / owner operational presence
Regulatory compliance overhead and government subsidy disbursement delays
